brief.headline: Push for Sayaji's ₹66.48/KG benchmark — we're paying ₹14.26 L/yr more than we should

priceAsk.summary: Match the ₹66.48/KG we pay Sayaji Industries for the same Dextrose Anhydrous IP
priceAsk.basis: We pay ₹75.51/KG here versus ₹66.48/KG to Sayaji — a 13.6% gap for identical material. Market asking prices for Anhydrous Dextrose IP run ₹60–81/kg (typically ₹66–73/kg), so our Sayaji price sits in the fair band. Universal must match it or we shift volume.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep 30 Days After Receipt — it's already reasonable and changing it won't free up meaningful cash for us

brief.financialLeverage: Universal Starch is healthy — they made ₹514.62 Cr in sales, keep about ₹3.70 of every ₹100 sold, and are growing fast (21.4%/yr). Our ₹59.65 L spend is tiny — just 0.12% of their revenue — so we have almost no pull on our own. They want new orders to keep that growth going, but they don't need us. To get traction, bundle the ask with a volume commitment or clearly show we'll move to Sayaji or Gulshan Polyols if they don't match the price.

evidence.point: We pay 13.6% more than our best price for the same Dextrose
Sayaji gives us ₹66.48/KG — that's our benchmark
Market asking prices for Anhydrous Dextrose IP run ₹60–81/kg, typically ₹66–73/kg — verdict: MARKET-FAIR
We're a tiny customer — 0.12% of their ₹514.62 Cr in sales
They're growing sales fast and want volume

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker (₹2359.06 Cr revenue, health B 62/100) — established dextrose supplier, drop-in alternate to Sayaji; strong option if Universal won't budge

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist (₹821.13 Cr revenue, health C 53/100) — growing dextrose capacity, credible second source

risks: We're only 0.12% of their business — they can walk away easily; bundle this ask with a multi-year volume pledge or a clear threat to shift orders to Sayaji
Universal's health score is C (58/100) — not great but not distressed; push firmly but don't expect them to cave without a real alternative lined up
Sayaji is our best price today, but we haven't qualified Gulshan or Sanstar yet — start that process now so we have real backup if this negotiation stalls
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the relationship, but we're paying ₹75.51/KG here when Sayaji gives us ₹66.48 for the same Dextrose — we need you at that price to keep the volume with you.
